messages.subject: Typeface for geom_text
parts:
Is it possible to change the typeface for geom_text elements? I am
trying to make the resulting text from geom_text bold so it stands
out.

I have tried using face = "bold" to the list of arguments to
geom_text...no error is produced and the typeface looks the same.

Any help is appreciated.
